name: Almia Agraliel
original_name: アルミア＝アグラリエル
source:
Princess of the Agraliel Kingdom and the sole daughter of Ephildis, the reigning queen.
She is of high elf lineage and is proud of her noble bloodline. Because of the pressure to succeed her mother, who is said to be a wise ruler, she is very strict with herself and others and due to her royal disposition she is quite conceited towards others.
Unlike her mother though she is interested in swordsmanship and takes up training under Narrus.
